subject: Future Tech
title: What Is Nanotechnology?
description: Learn What Is Nanotechnology? in one minute.

hook.text: A nanometer is one billionth of a meter. A human hair is 80,000 nanometers wide.

buildup.text: At the nanoscale, materials behave differently. Gold turns red. Aluminum becomes explosive.

discovery.text: Nanotech is atomic-level engineering: building atom by atom with precision nature took billions of years to master.

twist.text: Richard Feynman predicted nanotech in 1959 with his famous talk: 'There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom.

climax.text: Today, nanotech is a $90 billion industry touching medicine, electronics, energy, and materials.

punchline.text: The smallest engineering creates the biggest changes.

quiz.question: How wide is a human hair in nanometers?
